verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the required public-page flow: it navigated to Spotify, dismissed the cookie dialog, used only vertical scrolling, and waited for the catalog. Its actions did not cause the Home panel failure. The catalog requests were already failing immediately after navigation, before the later scroll and wait steps.
